prompt: A locked, dim, grainy night frame from a lens fixed in the rafters of the attic, looking down on Brandon hunched on the edge of a bare mattress with his phone held close to his face, thumbs poised, brows drawn together, eyelids narrowed, lips slightly parted, eyes aimed at the device. The phone's glow is a pale cold wash on his chin and nose, and its face is turned away from us as a blur of light. The rest of the attic is almost black apart from the edge of a pillow and a mug on the floor. The colour is washed out and compressed. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
